case_title: CHRISTINA J. RZESNIOWIECKI VS. LINDA KAHN

docket_entries.description: MONEY CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $842.10 FILED BY RZESNIOWIECKI, CHRISTINA J. AS TO DEFENDANT KAHN, LINDA ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR OCT-07-2009 AT 03:30 PM IN DEPT 506

CASE DISMISSED WITHOUT PREJUDICE. NO PROOF OF SERVICE. PROOF OF SERVICE IS INVALID - PROOF OF SERVICE FILE TODAY INDICATES BOTH PERSONAL AND SUB SERVICE DONE. APPEARANCE BY PLAINTIFF. NO APPEARANCE BY DEFENDANT. CLERK: S. VANTREE. NOT REPORTED. (506)
